name: synthetic-submit-rejected
description: SYNTHETIC: Kling rejects the create-task call with HTTP 400 and its own envelope — code 1201 and the rule text v1's drill recorded for 720p + native audio on 2.6. No task is created, so nothing will ever be billed and the run settles as zero-billed data with the vendor's status.

body.message: model/resolution(kling-v2-6/720p) is not supported when audio is native
